title: Automatic calibration process of G6 when G6 mg/dl and xDrip mmol not working?
symptom: When using a US G6 transmitter (mg/dl) with xDrip set to mmol, calibrations from an Accu-Chek Aviva Connect do not appear to be sent to the G6 (red squares don't turn round) and do not show up in the calibration table or graph, even though logs indicate calibrations are happening. Switching to mg/dl makes calibrations work visibly.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. A maintainer suggests that for G6 transmitters with serial numbers after 81XXXX, the transmitter does not send raw values, so xDrip cannot show anything on the calibration graph and such transmitters cannot use non-native mode. This may explain the empty calibration graph but not the calibration sending issue.
fix: No explicit fix is provided. The user reports that auto-calibrations still work, so it is not considered an issue. The maintainer suggests asking in support channels for answers.
evidence_quote: unless the first two characters of the serial number are 80 or 81, the transmitter does not send raw values. That may be why the calibration graph is empty.
